node.title: Re: Onkeyup not working
node.author: Corion
node.doctext:
If you were using [mod://strict], Perl would tell you where you go wrong. Add the following as the second line of your script:

use strict;

Don't use an interpolating string then. Use a single quoted string:

print <<'HTML';

You forgot to escape an @.

Also, consider using a proper template instead of inlining HTML into your code. See [mod://Template], [mod://Mojolicious::Lite] or [mod://HTML::Template].
